svg.title: Anthropic's newest, priciest model is its least-used, by the one ledger that bills
svg.desc: A bar chart of model-spend shares descending left-to-right from a tall incumbent bar to a short highlighted flagship stub, crossed by an upward revenue arrow. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Anthropic's newest, priciest model is its least-used, by the one ledger that bills”. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 4123802942.
